channel.title: Trafix
channel.description: Trafix shows true-profit ROAS for Meta and Google ads, net of returns and fees, flags creative fatigue and moves budget to what actually pays.

item.title: True-profit ROAS: why your 400% return may be losing money

item.title: How to evaluate agency performance beyond vanity metrics
item.description: A practical scorecard for judging a paid-media agency on profit, not platform ROAS, CTR or impressions. Questions to ask and data to request.

item.description: Seven hidden costs that platform dashboards miss, from attribution overlap to discount leakage, and how to find each one in your own data.

item.title: Pre-spend creative scoring: test ideas before you pay the auction
item.description: How pre-spend creative clickability scoring works, why it cuts testing waste on Meta and Google, and how to fit it into your creative workflow.

item.description: How to spot diminishing returns on Meta and Google campaigns and reallocate budget using marginal true-profit ROAS, with a simple weekly method.
